run_classification_lda: run Linear Discriminant Analysis classification with standard, Ledoit-Wolf, and OAS shrinkage estimators
generate_classification_data: generate random blob data with one discriminative feature and noisy features for LDA classification
build_lda_classifier: build an LDA classifier using lsqr solver with no shrinkage for classification
build_lda_classifier_ledoit_wolf: build an LDA classifier with Ledoit-Wolf automatic shrinkage for improved classification
build_lda_classifier_oas: build an LDA classifier with OAS covariance estimator for high-dimensional classification
